records.title: Structured Programming
records.content: COMP1110 is a 6 unit course about structured programming, object-oriented design and software construction. Prerequisites are COMP1100, COMP1130 or COMP1730.

records.title: Programming as Problem Solving
records.content: COMP1100 is a 6 unit course about functional programming and computational problem solving.

records.title: Algorithms
records.content: COMP2200 covers algorithms, graph theory, data structures and complexity analysis.

records.title: Marine Ecology
records.content: BIOL9001P covers marine ecosystems, biodiversity and field research.

records.title: Bachelor of Accounting
records.content: The Bachelor of Accounting covers accounting, financial reporting and auditing.

records.title: Computing Merit Scholarship
records.content: Open scholarship for domestic undergraduate computing students. Value is $5,000. Applications close 31 October 2026.

records.title: International Science Scholarship
records.content: Open scholarship for international postgraduate science students. Personal eligibility cannot be determined from this summary.

records.title: Engineering Equity Scholarship
records.content: Equity scholarship for undergraduate engineering students experiencing financial hardship.

records.title: Research Travel Grant
records.content: Travel funding for current postgraduate research students presenting at an academic conference.

records.title: Closed Computing Scholarship
records.content: Closed scholarship for undergraduate computing students. Applications closed 31 July 2026.

records.title: Yukeembruk
records.content: Self-catered residence on Acton campus. Single studios from $340 per week, study rooms, shared kitchens and an application portal. Current vacancy status is not published.

records.title: Bruce Hall
records.content: Catered residence on Acton campus with dining hall meals, common rooms and undergraduate accommodation.

records.title: Ursula Hall
records.content: Catered residence with communal dining, music rooms and academic support spaces.

records.title: Burgmann College
records.content: Catered residential college with meals, sports facilities and community activities.

records.title: Wright Hall
records.content: Flexi-catered residence. The stored source says applications are closed and no vacancies are published.

records.title: Software Engineer
records.content: Current professional role developing Python services and web applications. Applications close 27 September 2026. Requirements include software engineering experience.

records.title: Research Officer
records.content: Current fixed-term research role supporting laboratory data analysis. Applications close 30 September 2026.

records.title: Student Administration Officer
records.content: Current administrative role supporting student services. Applications close 4 October 2026.

records.title: Cyber Security Analyst
records.content: Current information technology role covering cyber security monitoring and incident response. Direct-page requirements were not captured.

records.title: ANU Open Day
records.content: Official ANU Open Day on 26 September 2026 from 10:00 to 14:00 at the ANU Acton campus, organised by The Australian National University.

records.title: Research Lecture
records.content: Official ANU research lecture on 26 September 2026 at 18:30 in Llewellyn Hall, organised by the Research School.

records.title: Climate Seminar
records.content: Official ANU climate seminar on 27 September 2026 at 11:00 in the Fenner Seminar Room.

records.title: Student Music Meetup
records.content: Approved bounded Rubric student music meetup on 26 September 2026 at 19:00. The organiser and venue are not published.

records.title: Board Games Night
records.content: Approved bounded Rubric board games event on 27 September 2026 at 17:30 in Kambri.

records.title: Academic Support
records.content: ANUSA Academic Support helps with unfair grades, assessment concerns, grade appeals and academic difficulty. The service is free.

records.title: Financial Support
records.content: ANUSA Financial Support helps students experiencing money stress or financial hardship. Published opening hours are not available.

records.title: Legal Service
records.content: ANUSA Legal Service provides free legal advice to ANU students on tenancy, employment and other legal problems.

records.title: Student Safety and Wellbeing
records.content: Support for students experiencing harassment, safety concerns or wellbeing difficulties, with published referral pathways.

records.title: International Student Support
records.content: Support for international students with study, community and referral questions.
